thread:
Marta: Quick follow-up to the kernel-selection RFC — need explicit rollout controls for per-model kernel variants and deterministic fallbacks. Capturing decisions and owners.

Sam: Scope? global/model/route/tenant?

Devon: All of them. Order of precedence: model.override -> route.hint -> global.default. Model owners can opt-in to rollouts.

Lee: Add a global emergency switch that forces the platform-wide fallback model; ops can toggle with RBAC.

Marta: Proposed lookup order:
- global.default_kernel
- model.overrides[model_id] (object: variant + rollout_pct)
- route.hints
- auto-fallback (metric-triggered)
- emergency_disable

Sam: Support percent rollouts? deterministic hashing?

Devon: Yes. rollout_pct interpreted as integer 0-100; selection via hash(request_key, seed) < rollout_pct.

Jenna: Dedicated tenants: default to pinned (100%) unless customer opts into partial.

Marta: Fallback policy suggestion:
1) alternate kernel variant for same model
2) smaller/compat model
3) global fallback model
4) fail 503 + incident marker

Sam: Detecting SLO breach: moving window p95/p99 by (route,model). OOMs separate.

Lee: OOMs should prefer smaller-model route; latency prefers alt kernel.

Devon: Telemetry events required: kernel_selected, kernel_fallback(reason), fallback_chain, rollout_bucket(variant,pct,seed), variant_hits. Include kernel tag in trace/span.

Marta: Add response headers: x-rw-kernel, x-rw-fallback (short keys). Also emit them into debug logs for non-prod.

Sam: Storage & perf: flags in config-service with runtime caching + soft TTL; lookup O(1); hashing cheap.

Devon: Will prototype cache and add microbench; target <200ns lookup. Also add unit tests for rollout determinism.

Jenna: Dashboards: per-variant p50/p95/p99, fallback-rate, reason breakdown, variant traffic share. Alerts: fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m -> page.

Marta: Owners & deadlines:
- flag schema PR: Sam (Thu EOD)
- runtime eval + cache: Devon + Lee (end of sprint)
- hashing util: Sam (this week)
- telemetry + dashboards: Jenna (next week)
- emergency API + RBAC: Marta (ASAP)

Devon: Integration test plan: induce kernel crash, assert fallback chain order, assert telemetry sequence.

Sam: Release plan: staging -> prod canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Rollback if fallback_rate > 1%.

Marta: Small UX ask: allow rollout policies (absolute now, ramping later). Add a one-paragraph test plan to PRs.

deploy-bot: [deploy] flag-service 0.13.0 rolled to canary window.

Marta: Thanks — I'll file the follow-up doc and assign tickets. Closing thread after doc posted.
